{{Quote|It's complicated, but with the right energy source, yes&mdash;those geothermal capacitors could help power a starship.|Major Odis Valyn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''geothermal capacitor''' was a geothermal power generator that was used in the depths of [[the Tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Geothermal capacitors were also used in [[Imperial Capacitor-style garrison]]s during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
